title: Connect to Fathom's MCP server
snippet:
# Connect to Fathom's MCP server
Query and analyse your Fathom data in your chosen AI tool or platform
🎉 **Beta feature:** Fathom's MCP is currently in beta, so you must **[turn on the beta flag](https://support.fathomhq.com/en/articles/9321926-beta-features)** to access it. If you run into any issues or have feedback, please reach out to our team at [support@fathomhq.com](mailto:support@fathomhq.com).
# What is an MCP server?
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides your AI tool with access to your Fathom data and the **context the tool needs to understand the data**.
By connecting Fathom’s MCP server, your AI tool has the logic behind how the data relates to one another, not just the hard-coded numbers. MCP servers help AI tools, like large-language models (LLMs), understand your data when you ask a natural language question, so the tool can retrieve and reference the correct data.
## What can you do with Fathom's MCP server?
With Fathom’s MCP server, you can use natural language to interrogate and analyse your Fathom data in your chosen AI tool (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, etc.).
📝 **Note:** We've heard from users that the "free version" of Claude does not allow you to use PAT tokens to connect to MCPs, including Fathom's MCP server.
​You can bring your Fathom data into your connected AI tool, but you cannot send instructions or data back into Fathom.
| Fathom's MCP server will provide the connected AI tool with the following types of data: |
|---|
| - The Fathom organisations or accounts you are a member of ​ - The companies connected to your Fathom organisation(s) that you can access ​ - P&L data for your entities ​ - Balance Sheet data for your entities ​ - KPI data for your entities ​ - Cash flow statement data for your entities ​ - Chart of accounts data for your entities |
Forecast and budget data currently cannot be accessed via Fathom's MCP server.
---
# How to connect to Fathom's MCP server
You can connect your AI tool to Fathom’s MCP server with a Personal Access Token (PAT). The PAT will provide your AI tool with read-only access to your data in Fathom.
Because PATs are specific to the individual, your PAT will be able to read data according to your personal role and permissions in Fathom. You cannot access additional data in Fathom with your PAT.
📝 **Note:** OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini do not support PAT connection, so it is currently not possible to connect them to Fathom's MCP server.

title: AI Meeting Notetaker MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT
snippet:
# It’s your meeting. Bring context into Claude, ChatGPT, and the AI tools you use.
Fathom’s AI meeting notetaker MCP server connects your meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP-compatible tools, so your AI assistant can answer questions and draft work from what was actually said.

### Connect in a few steps, on the permissions you already have.
Add the Fathom app in ChatGPT or the Fathom connector in Claude, or point any MCP-compatible tool at Fathom’s MCP server and sign in. Your assistant can only reach meetings you can already view in Fathom. MCP doesn’t open up any new data.

Fathom MCP works with ChatGPT (through the Fathom app), Claude (through the Fathom connector or Claude Code), and any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL https://api.fathom.ai/mcp.

title: Claude
snippet:
Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude:
### Steps:
1. Go to the **[Fathom connector for Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/fathom)**.
If you’re using Claude in a team or organization, an owner must first enable the connector before it will appear for members.
1. Click **Connect** and complete the authorization prompts.
That’s it! You can now ask Claude about your meetings.
## Claude Code
Claude Code supports adding MCP servers directly from the command line. Run the following command in your terminal:
```
claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
```
The Fathom MCP server will now be available in your Claude Code sessions.

# Fathom AI MCP Server
**Connect Claude to your Fathom meetings, transcripts, and AI summaries.**

Get Started | Available Tools | [API Docs](https://www.fathom-mcp-server.com/docs) | Self-Hosting | [Contributing](/agencyenterprise/fathom-mcp-server/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

This server is published to the [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) as `io.github.agencyenterprise/fathom-mcp-server`.
### Claude Desktop (Streamable HTTP)
Connect in under 60 seconds:
```
https://www.fathom-mcp-server.com/mcp
```
1. Open **Claude Desktop**
2. Go to **Settings > Connectors > Add Custom Connector**
3. Paste the URL above
4. Authenticate with Fathom
That's it. Ask Claude about your meetings.

### Custom MCP Tools
#### `search_meetings`
Search Fathom meetings by title, meeting title, host name, host email, or attendee name/email. Automatically scans up to 5 pages of results. This is an MCP-native tool that performs client-side filtering since Fathom's API doesn't provide a search endpoint.
See the [Fathom MCP Server documentation](https://www.fathom-mcp-server.com/docs) for full request and response parameters.

title: Fathom MCP: Connect Claude & ChatGPT
snippet:
**MCP (Model Context Protocol)** lets you connect Fathom to AI assistants like **Claude** and **ChatGPT**, so you can ask questions about your meetings and create work products (emails, plans, briefs, etc.) without having to copy/paste meeting content.
## What you can do with the MCP integration
- Ask Claude/ChatGPT questions about your meetings.
- Draft follow-ups, QBR narratives, action plans, and other deliverables using meeting context.
- Combine Fathom meeting context with other context you already use in Claude/ChatGPT (docs, notes, plans, etc.)
## What data can Claude/ChatGPT access?
- The integration can only access meetings **you already have permission to view** in Fathom.
- MCP doesn't provide access to new categories of data - it mainly makes it easier for Claude/ChatGPT to retrieve the meeting context you need.
## Setting Up the Integration
**ChatGPT**
1. Go to the [Fathom app for ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_69d88b99c5c481918e8da9225737e1e9)
2. Click **Connect** and complete the authorization prompts
3. That's it! Just type @Fathom to query your meetings
**Claude**
1. Go to the [Fathom connector for Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/fathom) (if you’re using Claude in a team or organization, an owner must first enable the connector before it will appear for members).
2. Click **Connect** and complete the authorization prompts.
3. That’s it! You can now ask Claude about your meetings.
**Other Tools**
To learn more about Fathom's MCP and how to connect it to any other MCP-compatible tool, visit [api.fathom.ai/mcp](http://api.fathom.ai/mcp).
## When should you use MCP vs Account-Wide Ask Fathom?
### Use **Account-Wide Ask Fathom** when:
- You want a quick answer or synthesis across meetings directly inside Fathom.
- You don’t need to create the output elsewhere.
### Use the **MCP integration** when:
- You want meeting context available inside Claude/ChatGPT.
- You want to create deliverables outside Fathom or combine meeting context with other sources.
**Quick rule:** Quick rule: Use Ask Fathom when you want answers and insights directly in Fathom. Use the MCP integration when you want to work with meeting context in your AI assistant, including asking questions, combining it with other sources, or creating deliverables.
